name: sgs/whatsapp-cta
title: SGS WhatsApp CTA
description: WhatsApp integration with floating button, inline CTA, or banner variants.

button.label: Button
button._note: Contract §B3 single-semantic-element block — the <a> IS the block root (no wrapper div); it plays both the wrapper and the button/label element. labelColour/labelFontSize/labelFontWeight/labelFontStyle resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention (prefix: 'label'). labelColourGradient RE-KEYED 2026-09-06 (FILL closeout) from css:background-image to css:color-gradient — it paints a TEXT gradient via background-clip:text (sgs_resolve_text_colour_or_gradient(), scoped to the CHILD .sgs-whatsapp-cta__label span, render.php D948), the same semantic key product-card's ctaColourTextGradient already uses; the old key wrongly claimed css:background-image on this element and made the classifier think the ROOT's background-fill gradient sibling already existed when it didn't. css:background-image now correctly maps to the real button-fill gradient, backgroundColourGradient, scoped to the ROOT <a> (render.php, different selector from the label span — no runtime collision, both properties genuinely coexist).

message.default: Hi, I'd like to know more about your services.

backgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the button's resting background via background-image, scoped to the root `<a>` (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06). Non-empty wins over backgroundColour.

backgroundColourHover.description: Button background colour on :hover/:focus-visible — the button's own :hover rule previously only animated opacity/transform, no colour change existed. Falls back to backgroundColour, then the theme default, when unset.

backgroundColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the button's :hover background via background-image. Non-empty wins over backgroundColourHover; falls back to backgroundColourGradient, then none.
